dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You must be very good at cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Hehe, this client has a way with words. Even though I'm not famous, I'm confident in my abilities when it comes to the seasoning of Inazuma snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Here, I've cooked a fresh batch. Would you like to try some they are still hot?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: It seems like you're an outlander. If the food isn't to your tastes, I can specially adjust the seasoning just for you.
